source_text: A cross-sectional survey study by Frisch et al. (2011) in Denmark, where circumcision is rare (~5%), reported associations between circumcision and increased frequent orgasm difficulties in men (11% vs 4%, adj OR 3.26, 95% CI 1.42-7.47) and various sexual difficulties in female partners of circumcised men, including dyspareunia (adj OR 8.45, 95% CI 3.01-23.74).
